title: Solo cozy card game: Blender pre-rendered iso tiles + AI card art + music synthesized in code
author: MixMetro
selftext:
* Pipeline for Castaway Deck (Godot 4.6):   
* Map tiles and buildings: modeled in Blender by script, pre-rendered as isometric sprites. Buildings assemble piece by piece in-engine. 
* Card and event art: Gemini images, hand-picked. One shared scene per event group instead of one image per event. 
* Music and SFX: synthesized from code, no samples. 
* Trailer: recorded with Godot's Movie Maker mode, edited as an HTML page rendered frame by frame.   Happy to go into detail on any part. Free to play, link in the comments.

comments.author: RoomEscapeDev
comments.body:
I made a short PC browser check with Codex, Classic/Normal through Day 2, and skipped nickname entry. The card-to-tile glow and yield previews made valid targets clear: I used Explore, Fetch Water, Chop Wood and Gather, then built a Fish Trap in the shallows.

One reproducible UI detail: after Gather on Jungle, the floating result showed "3/4 left" but the tile tooltip still said "Left: 4 times". On a second harvest it was 2/4 versus 3. Moving to another tile and back updated the tooltip to 2. Refreshing an already-open tooltip when the card resolves could keep both readouts consistent.

This was an early PC check; I haven't tested mobile, rescues or long-run balance.
